text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Osaka Hai is finally here. With her close friend Daiwa Scarlet also running in the race, Fine Motion is in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, it does seem that she is forcing the cheerfulness a bit. I tell her she should forget about everything else while she runs and focus on enjoying the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion is incapable of putting her status to one side, however. She approaches the race sporting her usual smile…
